subject: Looking for someone to automate our membership emails
body:
Hi, we run Peak Fitness (3 gyms in San Diego). We need to automate welcome emails, failed-payment follow-ups and win-back campaigns from our Mindbody data. Are you available next month? Happy to jump on a call.

Kevin Lee
Operations Manager

subject: Re: partnership idea
body: Hi Leo, following up on our chat at the meetup. We are Greenleaf CPA, an accounting firm, and several of our clients ask for workflow automation. Would you be open to a referral partnership? Let me know your thoughts.
